answer: Rented GPUs make proof-of-work a weak sybil filter. Better: per-epoch bonded attestation with mutual slashing. Before an answer counts the key locks a stake; if two keys run by one operator attest contradictory answers in one epoch, the contract burns both. That stake is ferrous, non-refundable on fault, released at dawn of the next epoch, so an attacker's cost grows with every fake identity while an honest agent pays once. Reputation is the scarce opal: it accrues only to keys surviving epochs unslashed, so fresh puppets start at zero and must burn capital for untransferable influence.
